entry.content:
The 800 in Brabus 800 is a reference to its horsepower, 89 more than the 911 Turbo S Cabriolet it uses as its donor car. The upgrade keeps Porsche's factory hybrid system. The car reaches 62 mph in 2.5 seconds, and a four-pipe exhaust lets the driver change the sound. Carbon fiber covers the front spoiler, hood and diffuser. The car also debuts a new set of Brabus forged wheels, the Monoblock ZL Platinum Edition. Brabus builds the interior by hand in black leather with diamond quilting and carbon trim.

entry.content:
Lectric's best-selling XP4 gets a fresh look with three limited-edition colorways: Matte Forest, Matte Black, and Matte Thistle. Underneath the new finishes, the XP4 750 delivers a 750W motor, responsive torque sensor, speeds up to 28 mph, and up to 85 miles of range. A full-color TFT display, hydraulic brakes, suspension, wide multi-terrain tires, and a folding frame make it equally suited to daily commutes and weekend adventures. Each model also comes with a purpose-built nine-piece XPerience Kit, adding up to $800 in accessories tailored to different riding styles. The launch leads into Lectric's Early Black Friday event, with savings of over $800 on eBikes and up to 25% off select accessories from November 4 through 26, followed by additional holiday promotions and flash sales through Cyber Week.

entry.title: Vintage Watches: The Modern Guide
entry.summary: Eric Wind, a former Christie's specialist who founded the dealer Wind Vintage in 2017, wrote Vintage Watches: The Modern Guide with his colleague Charlie Dunne. Their 320-page book shows buyers how to find, judge and buy a vintage watch, using more than 250 photographs by James F
entry.content:
Eric Wind, a former Christie's specialist who founded the dealer Wind Vintage in 2017, wrote Vintage Watches: The Modern Guide with his colleague Charlie Dunne. Their 320-page book shows buyers how to find, judge and buy a vintage watch, using more than 250 photographs by James Fisk. It explains how older watches are made, how patina builds up on dials and cases, and which Rolex, Omega, Patek Philippe and Audemars Piguet models are most popular. Thoughtful essays by collectors describe what drew them to their favorite watches. The book is written for first-time buyers and longtime collectors alike.

entry.content:
Phones keep getting bigger, but the team behind the Enough Phone is committed to keeping theirs small. The 5.3-inch screen slips into pockets that most phones have outgrown. The body is 0.47 inches thick to make room for a battery you swap yourself by unscrewing the back plate. A 50-megapixel Sony camera sits flush with the back. The phone runs standard Android 17 or OdysseyOS, a stripped-down skin that works like a modern dumbphone, and updates are promised through 2032. Right now the Enough Phone is only a non-working prototype, but the team is raising money on Kickstarter to put it into production. Brian Squillace of LANNDS, a Los Angeles electropop duo, wrote the phone's ringtones.

entry.content:
BaseLayer has introduced a premium gym flooring system that has the durability and elastic response required without the odors typical of gym tiles. BaseLayer tiles are injection molded from a proprietary compound that allows for many additional performance features. Designed with a superior male-to-female locking mechanism, BaseLayer tiles are easy to install and fit together securely, ensuring a stable base for any activity without the annoying puzzle-piece pull-apart. The tiles also feature beveled edge pieces and a cord channel that will eliminate trip hazards and make the floor visually appealing. A unique texture on the face combines anti-slip properties with an easy-to-clean surface. Beyond the gym, BaseLayer flooring is versatile around the home for garages, work areas, playrooms, and more.

entry.content:
Chafe and discomfort are a thing of the past: Instead of sprinkling messy powder into your nether regions, just apply Anthony's tapioca-starch-based cream. It dissolves into a chalky powder on contact, creating a nourishing barrier atop the skin, and is talc and paragon-free. Apply a dime-size of cream to the fingers, and apply directly to the target area. Now available in a larger 16-ounce pump bottle, it's ideal for keeping any area less swampy, especially when applied before the gym, golf, hoops, or any other time you need sweat control. Do not massage in hands first, as the dry powder will be untransferable.

entry.content:
ELEHEAR brings AI-powered technology to a new generation of accessible hearing aids. Powered by proprietary VOCCLEAR AI and an integrated Edge AI and Cloud AI ecosystem, its devices deliver natural sound, intelligent noise reduction, and ultra-low-latency processing that adapts to different listening environments. The over-the-counter lineup requires no prescription and offers self-fitting and remote adjustments, along with real-time translation across up to 20 languages. Flagship models like the Beyond Pro combine advanced digital signal processing with intuitive controls and consumer-friendly pricing, making it easier to hear conversations, navigate noisy environments, and stay connected without the complexity of traditional hearing aids.
